sloka: तथा शार्ङ्गविनिर्मुक्ताः शरा नारायणेरिताः ।निर्धावन्तीषवस्तूर्णं शतशोथ सहस्रशः ।। ७.७.१९ ॥
transliteration: tathā śārṅgavinirmuktāḥ śarā nārāyaṇeritāḥ ।nirdhāvantīṣavastūrṇaṁ śataśotha sahasraśaḥ ।। 7.7.19 ॥

translations.english: Similarly, arrows released from the Śārṅga bow and propelled by Nārāyaṇa rushed forth swiftly by hundreds and thousands.
